comment: The panel prints SUM- and the manual calls it the difference of the two inputs, but the code computes 1V minus the sum of the two attenuated channels. The line follows the code. Input 2 and outputs 2 and 3 are declared in the code, are not placed on the panel and are never read. The pan CV is discontinuous at exactly 0V. VCA.cpp:69 and 80 test the voltage with if(cv), so at exactly zero the plain cosine and sine pan law is used, and at any other voltage — including a vanishingly small one — the gains are multiplied by 1+(cv+1)/5 on the left and 1-(cv-1)/5 on the right, which is a step change of a fifth as the voltage leaves zero.
